remaining_boundaries: No new live Slack, Discord, Telegram or WhatsApp installation/model acceptance was performed for this component.

Shared official Slack member-bot installation, bot scopes/events, signing custody and authenticated installation-to-host intake still require configuration and live qualification; MCP user connector grants remain separate.
Hosts must map every recipient to an authorized principal and agent capability grant; a complete provider audience is evidence, not permission.

Discord guild audience requires explicit members_intent and its vendor grant; threads/group DMs, Telegram groups and WhatsApp typed dispatch remain denied when full authenticated audience proof is unavailable.
Provider membership lookup and publication are not atomic; host policy must reject stale evidence and account for provider-side races.
The legacy standalone WebSocket TextFinal contract has no durable provider event ID; its restart-safe external event deduplication is not qualified.
Core24 qualification is a minimal installed import/dependency smoke; actual public runtime parity was exercised on Core26.
This independent component does not publish a new standalone App, server or CLI product build.
